name: io.github.forgeopslabs/appstore-mcp
title: App Store Connect
description: MCP server for the Apple App Store Connect API - 126 annotated tools, optional read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Store Connect issuer UUID (Users and Access -> Integrations).

environmentVariables.name: ASC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: The App Store Connect API key's Key ID.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the downloaded .p8 private key (or use ASC_PRIVATE_KEY for inline PEM).

environmentVariables.name: ASC_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to serve only tools that cannot modify the account.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to serve (e.g. 'core' or 'testflight,provisioning'). Defaults to all.

environmentVariables.name: ASC_TOOL_DISCOVERY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only search, inspect, and call discovery tools.
